_comment: (TASK-934/M) Per-model, per-window CER baseline map — schema_version 2. Keyed "<model slug>@<window_s>" so a row's decode-window change cannot silently change what the gate measures (test_mlen_quality_gate.py reads window_s from the SELECTED entry and passes it to WhisperCppAsrAdapter as max_decode_window_sec, exactly the ResolvedAsrSpec.models.asr.metadata.maxDecodeWindowSec path — TASK-880). METRICS ONLY (no transcript text) — the clinical audio + reference transcripts are PHI/PII and live OUTSIDE git (STT_MLEN_EVAL_DIR). Per-clip CER from the shipped WhisperCppAsrAdapter path (greedy decode, language ml-en auto-detect on the code-switch pair, clean sentence-level decode — no word-splitting, single utterance per clip, no VAD/streaming segmentation). Regenerate one entry with: python apps/stt/scripts/mlen_scorecard.py --clips-dir $STT_MLEN_EVAL_DIR --gguf $WHISPER_MLEN_GGUF --max-audio-seconds <window_s> --out <scratch.json> (NEVER --out straight onto this file — the script's raw output carries ref/hyp transcript text, which is PHI and must never reach git); then copy only mean_cer and the id→cer clips map into the matching key here (see README-mlen-eval.md). Model is deterministic (greedy) so re-runs are stable. Both current entries were captured 2026-09-09 WITHOUT a priming prompt (pair_priming_prompt=false, single_priming_prompt=false in the raw capture) — OD-11 (per-model initialPrompt) is still open; a future capture that turns the prompt on needs its own entry (window_s alone does not distinguish it) or an explicit prompt-state suffix. The RETIRED single-model f16 baseline (schema_version 1, captured pre-agent-cascade on window 'disabled'/whole-clip) was mean_cer 0.325 over 23 clips — kept here only as a comment; it predates the 24th clip (id "0", a ~19-minute stress clip added to the local eval set) and used a different decode geometry (no window guard) from either entry below, so it is not comparable and was not carried forward as data.

arcaai-whisper-large-ml-en-gguf-q8_0@7._note: captured through the same eval harness as the retired schema_version 1 baseline (WhisperCppAsrAdapter, 24 clips, STT_MLEN_EVAL_DIR). pair_priming_prompt=false, single_priming_prompt=false in the raw run (no agent initialPrompt applied) — OD-11 leaves the per-model prompt question open; this entry documents the OFF measurement only.
